boundaries_explained.client_playout: Browser reported its audio output went silent. Includes network, jitter buffer and device latency. This is the number the driver actually experiences.
boundaries_explained.server_flush: Agent stopped handing frames to the transport. Excludes the last network hop and the client jitter buffer, so it is optimistic relative to the ear by roughly one RTT/2 plus buffer depth.
boundaries_explained.server_first_frame: First synthesised audio frame handed to the transport. Measures the STT+LLM+Rime pipeline, not what reached the speaker.
boundaries_explained.client_first_audio: Browser rendered the first audible sample. End-to-end perceived response time.
boundaries_explained.in_process: Wholly inside the agent process. No transport involved, so no network component to separate out.
